hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y (positive steady-state gain).
At u=0, y decays on its own toward a low level due to self-drainage.
Response has small pure delay (<2s) plus multi-second lag to approach steady state.
No large dead-zone: small u>0 produces measurably more level than u=0.
Steady-state level is approximately linear in u across [0,1].
Steady-state u needed to hold target y=0.6 is in mid-range ~0.4-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (<+/-0.02) relative to 0.10 band so averaging permits control.
